title: How a P-Trap Preserves Indoor Air Quality
description: A P-trap is a critical fixture fitted beneath sinks, tubs, and drains to prevent harmful sewer gases from entering a building. Its unique curved geometry holds a standing pool of water after every discharge, creating a physical liquid barrier. This water seal blocks hazardous odors and gases while allowing wastewater and debris to pass freely during regular use. If a fixture remains unused for extended periods, this water barrier can evaporate, allowing sewer gas to penetrate living spaces. Understanding this water seal principle is fundamental to diagnosing foul drain odors in residential settings.
